name: Bendemeer West
summary: West of Bendemeer MRT toward Boon Keng — quieter NEL mid-town edges with HDB/condo mix and less nightlife tax than Jalan Besar.
body: Bendemeer West is the shortlist when North-East Line adjacency and calmer mid-town nights matter more than food-spine intensity. The pocket sits west of Bendemeer station toward Boon Keng gravity; housing mixes mature HDB with selective condo stock. Expats land here for car-light CBD hops without Jalan Besar weekend crush. Watch-outs: peak NEL loads, older-block hydrant clearance notices, and last-mile variance. Compare with Bendemeer East for Kallang Bahru-facing edges, Jalan Besar Fringe for denser food energy, and Farrer Park South when retail density wins.
